description: Dangerous write control over a published template lets the operator reshape it into an ESC1 posture, then enroll.

telemetry.detail: Template object modification (EKU / enrollment-flag / name-flag write) under DS-change auditing (default OFF).
Certificate Services received a certificate request (on the CA).
Certificate Services issued a certificate (on the CA).
PKINIT TGT request using the issued certificate - certificate-logon anomaly.
A template reconfiguration immediately followed by enrollment is a strong two-step behavioural signal.

abuse_primitive: Edit the template to enable SAN + client-auth, enroll as any user, then optionally revert.
notes: Adds a directory-modification event (5136) on top of the ESC1 issuance signature. Reverting the template is common and itself logs.
